name: Stella Lee
description: A woman from Thunder Junction who steals Arcavios artifacts through an Omenpath to sell on New Capenna.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Stella Lee, visiting Lucy Bluff's grave, hears the siblings arguing and meets them.
timeline.quote: Stella stepped around a crypt, and found herself looking at two pale, dark-haired people in tattered clothing.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The corpsipede attacks and all three flee to the necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: "Run," said the man, grabbing the woman by the arm and charging straight toward Stella.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella gives Geralf a bottle of angel's blood and lamp oil for free, as she has friends buried in the graveyard.
timeline.quote: "Then it's on the house." Stella tossed him the bottle

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa hums to track the foreign magic and leads them to a sealed Innistradi crypt, which Stella opens with her whip.
timeline.quote: When it struck the padlock, the shackle popped open and the lock fell away

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes the map from the sarcophagus and the group parts ways with Stella.
timeline.quote: reached inside the sarcophagus, rooting around until he came up with a map.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella lets the siblings go, and they ride away still bickering.
timeline.quote: "I suppose there's no captures between friends."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The twins secure the map to Maag Taranau at Thief's Folly with Stella Lee's help.
timeline.quote: they managed to disable the necromancy animating it and secure the map

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa triggers a trap in Thief's Folly, and with Stella Lee's help she and Geralf disable the zombie abomination and secure the map.
timeline.quote: Gisa accidentally triggered a trap and unleashed a zombie abomination that chased after the siblings.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint discovers Stella Lee packing the artifacts to take through an Omenpath for sale on New Capenna.
timeline.quote: I've got a buyer for old Arcavios artifacts over on New Capenna

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint summons ghostly echoes against Stella, who fights them off with a whip and escapes through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Stella Lee, moving fast now, leapt into the Omenpath and was gone

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

relations.note: Quint drives off Stella Lee, who is looting the cache.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

relations.quote: She is a friend of fellow Atiin
